text:
oliver: seeing intermittent 503s from apiserver in eu-west1, started right after the GPU pool scale-out at ~09:12 UTC. controller-manager spiked OOM kills a few times.

maria: same, watch cache lagged and leader election churned twice. logs show lots of fd_exhausted on kube-apiserver proxy.

ashley: @oliver can you paste the short apiserver log window? any obvious errors?

oliver: pasted snippet: `Apr 23 09:12:14 apiserver pod/apiserver-0: E0903 09:12:14.123 server.go:123] http: accept error: accept tcp 0.0.0.0:6443: too many open files`

raj: nat-port pool looks exhausted in that AZ, SNAT errors in cloud logs. Looks correlated with burst of GPU attach requests from Dedicated onboarding jobs.

maria: ah — the provisioner did a parallel attach for 120 GPUs, each init created 4 ephemeral conns to control plane during setup. that explains fd spike.

ashley: short-term mitigation: increase apiserver fd limit and bump kube-proxy conn tracking timeout? also can we throttle attach concurrency in provisioner?

oliver: bumped apiserver ulimit to 200k on the nodes in the canary zone, redeploying apiserver pods now.

sre-bot: deploy started for apiserver-canary (rev 2026.4)

raj: can we also add a circuit-breaker on provisioner side: max 8 parallel attaches per node pool and backoff when SNAT rate > 80%? I can open PR.

maria: yes please. also add a metric for attach_fanout and a quota alert so we don't let it go to 120 again.

ashley: longer term: consider prefix/KV caching for onboarding RPCs and reusing control plane connections during attach flow — would reduce conn churn. also evaluate cost tradeoff: slow attach vs reserved capacity.

oliver: tracked action items: 1) raj PR for concurrency throttle (ETA today) 2) infra ulimit bump rolled to canary (in progress) 3) metrics/alert for attach_fanout (maria) 4) design doc for durable attach path + caching (ashley).

maria: filing incident note and tagging customers affected by latency spikes. cc @oncall for follow-up. :warning:

ashley: rolling the apiserver canary patch now, will monitor latency and leader election events for 15m.

oliver: canary looks stable at +10m, leader elections subsided, controller-manager OOMs not observed after ulimit bump. leaving thread open until PR merges.

raj: opened PR #5489 to gate attach concurrency and backoff logic, includes tests.

maria: thanks — please link the PR in the incident note and set a low-severity postmortem tag.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0412-apiserver-fd-spike (severity: P2)

oliver: moving to follow-up board. closing this thread when PR is live in prod. :thumbsup:
